protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

environment.machineLabel: MacBook Pro / Apple M1 Pro 8-core / 16 GiB / arm64

support.scope: Pinned Fusor q7 browser bundle; 6 CPU threads; speech generation only
support.notes: 18 spoken languages; English has US and UK locales. Male/female prompt controls do not establish a fixed-voice count. Only American English female is tested. Six-thread Fusor WASM q7 configuration; different weights/runtime/sampling from the official WebGPU GGUF configuration.

cells.voice: American English female (prompted style; no fixed speaker ID)
cells.precision: q7 weights; six-thread WebAssembly (upstream relaxed-SIMD build when supported)

settings.voice: American English female (prompted style; no fixed speaker ID)
settings.precision: Fusor q7 CPU bundle; six-thread WebAssembly (upstream relaxed-SIMD build when supported)
settings.systemPrompt: Perform TTS in American English using a female voice.
settings.frontend: Pinned official LFM3 chat template; canonical source span passed verbatim; reset before every span.
settings.textSampling: Official Audio/Omni greedy text defaults (temperature 0, top-p 1, top-k 1, presence penalty 0).
settings.speechSampling: Pinned variant defaults: temperature 0.4, top-k all, repetition penalty 1.2, recent-frame window 64. Benchmark seed 0 per source span overrides the upstream browser random seed.
settings.runtime: Fusor browser runtime from Space 572fc51e58808d3536bc8a8bea9d74a11b4b88bc; omni q7 bundle 09f4fc6ddbbb3cc6cd30f74b1e76cc894f4901f4.
settings.loadingCache: HTTP-streamed model parts; bypasses upstream OPFS caching. The browser HTTP cache may evict immutable local assets and refetch them. Initialization is outside generation timing.
settings.hostWork: CPU JavaScript scheduling and 24 kHz PCM transfer; neural inference and codec are in six-thread WebAssembly with upstream relaxed-SIMD selection.
settings.streaming: Official 24 kHz PCM drained from Runtime.speech() after every step, including the final EOS/finalize step.

capability.description: Explicit Fusor web-threaded-relaxed CPU runtime with 6 threads; separate untimed probe returned finite 24 kHz PCM. Probe excluded from timed synthesis.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
Raw WAV is saved locally; opt-in audio publication is separate from timing and automatic result submission.

AC power verified before run. Sequential headed Chrome; user applications left open. No overlapping inference or tests. Omni uses the reviewed HTTP-only loading fix after preserved pre-scoring OPFS loading failures; weights, neural runtime and speech settings unchanged. Six-thread q7 CPU is distinct from official GGUF WebGPU configuration. Different source cohort from prior Audio CPU. Cold-load checks excluded.

RSS is sampled every 500 ms across the owned Chrome process tree, including the Chrome baseline and inference workers. Whole-call peak spans post-timer validation/export; generation mean uses only in-window samples from browser generation start through final CPU-readable PCM.
